name: KAISERSPIEL
description: Trappola is an early Venetian trick-taking card game that spread through Central Europe and influenced later games including Stovkahra and Coteccio.

content.text: Trappola is an early Venetian trick-taking card game that spread through Central Europe and influenced later games including Stovkahra and Coteccio.

Trappola was current in Venice by the early sixteenth century and became popular in Central Europe from the seventeenth through nineteenth centuries; dedicated Trappola card production survived into the twentieth century.
2-4 players use the table arrangement described for Trappola.
